items.label: Demonstrable Economic Substance
items.text: An established business model with a credible and transparent track record.

items.label: Clear Market Positioning
items.text: Products or services with identifiable competitive advantages and sustainable market demand.

items.label: Strong Management
items.text: Entrepreneurs and leadership teams with experience, accountability and a clear vision for the company's next stage of development.

items.label: Growth & Value Creation Potential
items.text: Clearly identifiable opportunities to increase revenue, strengthen market position, improve profitability or enhance long-term enterprise value.

items.label: Transparent Structures
items.text: Clear financial, corporate and operational structures providing the foundation for professional investment due diligence.

paragraphs: We believe successful Private Equity investments are built on aligned interests and a shared long-term perspective.
Capital alone does not build a successful company. The decisive factors are the people, the strategy and the ability to transform existing potential into sustainable value.
Argentum Investments SA therefore follows a selective and long-term investment approach.

en/Private Equity.odt.text: We do not simply invest in companies. We invest in their next stage of development.

en/Private Equity.odt.title: Are You Considering a Strategic Capital Partner?

paragraphs: Are you an entrepreneur, shareholder or decision-maker of an established company considering growth, expansion, succession, an acquisition or a change in ownership structure?
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected Private Equity opportunities with an investment volume starting from EUR 2 million.
Present your company and strategic objectives to us on a confidential basis.

Every investment is subject to individual assessment, due diligence and final investment approval. The submission or evaluation of an investment opportunity does not create any entitlement to an investment and does not constitute a binding commitment to provide capital. Any participation by additional investment partners is subject to their own independent due diligence and investment decision.

en/Project Development.odt.title: Turning Compelling Concepts into Viable Projects.

paragraphs: A strong project concept is only the beginning. Its economic success depends on a clear strategy, a robust structure and access to the capital required to transform a plan into a viable investment.
Argentum Investments SA invests in selected project developments with compelling economic fundamentals and clearly defined implementation potential.
Our focus is on investment opportunities starting from EUR 2 million.

We seek projects where the concept, market opportunity, project partners and economic perspective have already reached a stage at which additional capital can provide the decisive step from planning to implementation.

en/Project Development.odt.text: We do not simply finance an idea. We invest in the viability of a vision.

paragraphs: Project developments require capital structures specifically adapted to their individual characteristics.

Unlike established companies, the economic value of a project is often created progressively – from concept and planning through approvals and implementation to successful completion or commercialization.
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected project developments with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
Our assessment considers not only the current stage of a project, but also the economic value it has the potential to create following successful implementation.
Our objective is to deploy capital where it enables a clearly defined development milestone and contributes measurably to the value creation of the overall project.
We are interested in projects that have progressed beyond the initial concept stage and already provide the essential foundations required for a professional investment assessment.
Depending on the opportunity, capital may be deployed at different stages of development:

items.label: Project Formation & Development
items.text: Capital to advance an already structured project and establish the conditions required for its next stage of development.

items.label: Planning & Preparation
items.text: Investment in selected planning, development and preparatory activities where these form part of a clearly defined and commercially viable overall project.

items.label: Acquisition & Project Takeover
items.text: Capital for the acquisition of project companies, rights, assets or other strategically relevant project components.

items.label: Implementation & Execution
items.text: Investment capital for projects that are ready to move from development into the implementation phase.

items.label: Expansion & Further Development
items.text: Capital for existing projects whose economic potential can be enhanced through expansion, additional locations or a subsequent stage of development.

items.label: Bridging Development Stages
items.text: Individually structured capital solutions for projects requiring additional funding between key development milestones.

en/Project Development.odt.title: We Invest in Projects with a Clear Perspective.

paragraphs: Not every compelling concept is automatically an investable project.
For us, an attractive project development opportunity begins when an idea has evolved into a structured and commercially viable proposition.
Our assessment focuses particularly on:

items.label: A Clearly Defined Project
items.text: The objectives, scope, business model and implementation strategy must be clearly and transparently presented.

items.label: Demonstrable Market Demand
items.text: The project should address genuine economic demand or a clearly identifiable target market.

items.label: Experienced Project Partners
items.text: Developers, sponsors and management teams must demonstrate the expertise required to execute the project successfully.

items.label: Realistic Project Economics
items.text: Costs, capital requirements, timelines, expected returns and material project risks must be presented transparently and credibly.

items.label: Defined Milestones
items.text: There should be a clear understanding of which development stages and objectives are expected to be achieved through the investment.

items.label: Credible Exit or Revenue Strategy
items.text: From the outset, there should be a realistic perspective on how the project will generate returns over time or how the invested capital can ultimately be realized.

en/Project Development.odt.title: Capital for Projects Across Different Sectors.

paragraphs: Our investment approach is not limited to a single industry.
Argentum Investments SA may evaluate selected project developments across a range of economic sectors where the structure, market potential and overall investment case are compelling.

These may include industrial and commercial developments, infrastructure projects, technology ventures, energy and sustainability projects, hospitality and tourism concepts, as well as other entrepreneurial developments with a clearly defined commercial objective.
The sector alone is not decisive.

en/Project Development.odt.text: What matters is whether the project has the potential to create sustainable, commercially viable and investable value.

paragraphs: Larger project developments often require capital structures that extend beyond the capacity or investment strategy of a single investor.
In addition to our own investment capabilities, Argentum Investments SA has access to an established network of selected private capital providers and investment partners.

Depending on the size, sector, stage of development and capital requirements of a project, an investment may be considered through our own capital or alongside selected private investment partners from our network.
This enables us to consider larger and more complex project developments for potential investment.

Argentum Investments SA does not operate as a traditional credit or capital intermediary. We evaluate each project as a specific investment opportunity in which we may participate directly or jointly with selected investment partners.
A significant capital requirement alone does not make a project investable.
The better a project is prepared, the more efficiently an investment decision can be made.

For an initial assessment, we therefore require a clear presentation of the project, its current development status, total investment volume, required capital, equity already committed, project partners, implementation timeline and intended commercial realization.
Our objective is to determine at an early stage whether the project, its capital requirements and a potential investment structure are aligned.
Timing can have a significant impact on costs, approvals, contractual arrangements and market opportunities in project development.
We therefore emphasize direct communication and a structured assessment process.
Provided that all required project, corporate and financing documentation is complete, a comprehensive initial investment assessment can generally be completed within three to four weeks.

Following a positive assessment and an initial investment decision, the subsequent structuring, finalization and implementation of the investment can in many cases be completed within a further three to four weeks.
For complex projects, additional technical, legal, regulatory or project-specific due diligence may require additional time.

items.label: Project Presentation
items.text: Submission of the project description, current development status, business plan, capital requirements, intended use of funds and proposed timeline.

items.label: Investment Assessment
items.text: Analysis of economic viability, market potential, project partners, capital structure, development risks and value creation potential.

items.label: Project & Capital Structure
items.text: Following a positive assessment, we evaluate which investment structure may be appropriate for the next stage of development.

items.label: Due Diligence
items.text: Detailed commercial, legal and – depending on the nature of the project – technical or sector-specific due diligence.

items.label: Investment Decision & Implementation
items.text: Following successful completion of due diligence and agreement on the relevant terms, a final investment decision is made and, if approved, the investment is implemented.

en/Project Development.odt.title: You Have the Vision. We Evaluate the Potential Behind It.

paragraphs: Have you developed a project, established its essential foundations and reached the stage where additional capital is required to take the next decisive step?
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected project development opportunities with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
Do not simply present us with an idea.

en/Project Development.odt.text: Show us what it can become.

en/Project Development.odt.label: SUBMIT YOUR PROJECT FOR INVESTMENT ASSESSMENT

paragraphs: Every project and investment is subject to individual assessment, due diligence and final investment approval. The submission or evaluation of a project does not create any entitlement to financing and does not constitute a binding commitment to provide capital. Any participation by additional investment partners is subject to their own independent assessment and investment decision. The stated timeframes are indicative and may vary, particularly for complex, technical, regulatory or approval-dependent projects.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.title: Capital for Real Estate with Substance and Potential.

paragraphs: Successful real estate projects require more than an attractive location and a compelling concept. A sound project structure, realistic financial planning and access to the right capital are essential to transforming an opportunity into sustainable value.
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected real estate financing opportunities with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.

Our focus is on property developers, real estate development companies, property owners and professional investors seeking private capital for the acquisition, development or realization of real estate projects.
We look beyond the property itself.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.text: We evaluate the investment as a whole.

paragraphs: Location, property fundamentals, development status, project strategy, capital structure, financial viability and exit potential collectively form the basis of our investment assessment.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.title: Real Estate Financing from EUR 2 Million

paragraphs: Argentum Investments SA focuses on selected real estate opportunities with financing requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
We do not view real estate financing as a standardized lending product.
Every project is assessed individually based on its commercial, financial and structural fundamentals.

Depending on the opportunity, different investment and capital structures may be considered. The key objective is to ensure that the financing structure, project stage and economic objectives are appropriately aligned.
Our aim is to deploy capital where a compelling real estate strategy is supported by sound economic fundamentals.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.title: For Property Developers, Project Developers & Real Estate Investors

paragraphs: We work with professional market participants who bring experience, a clearly defined project and a credible execution strategy.
Our interest extends from individual properties to larger-scale development projects.
We consider financing opportunities including:

items.label: Land & Property Acquisitions
items.text: Capital for the acquisition of suitable development sites, existing properties or strategically relevant real estate assets.

items.label: Property Development
items.text: Capital structures for selected new-build, development and redevelopment projects.

items.label: Residential & Commercial Real Estate
items.text: Capital for suitable residential, office, retail, logistics and mixed-use developments.

items.label: Existing Real Estate Assets
items.text: Financing for the acquisition, further development, repositioning or value enhancement of existing properties.

items.label: Redevelopment & Repositioning
items.text: Capital for properties where additional economic potential can be created through refurbishment, modernization, conversion or strategic repositioning.

items.label: Luxury & Premium Real Estate
items.text: Individual assessment of selected high-quality properties and developments in attractive locations.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.title: When Conventional Structures Are Not Enough.

paragraphs: Real estate projects do not always fit within the standardized parameters of traditional financing models.
Different development stages, complex ownership structures, project-specific risks or particular transaction circumstances may require more flexible capital solutions.
This is where private capital can provide additional possibilities.

Argentum Investments SA evaluates each opportunity from an investor's perspective and considers which capital structure may be appropriate in light of the project's specific characteristics and economic fundamentals.
Depending on the individual investment, this may include equity, equity-related capital, mezzanine capital or other individually structured forms of private capital.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.text: Not every real estate project requires the same financing. That is why our approach begins with the project – not with a standardized product.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.title: Our Capital. Private Investment Partners. Greater Possibilities.

paragraphs: In addition to our own investment capabilities, Argentum Investments SA has access to an established network of selected private capital providers and investment partners.
Depending on the size, location and structure of a real estate opportunity, financing may be considered through our own capital or alongside selected investment partners from our network.
This allows us to evaluate larger real estate projects as well as opportunities requiring more individualized capital structures.

Argentum Investments SA does not operate as a traditional bank or credit intermediary. We assess real estate projects as specific investment opportunities in which we may participate directly or jointly with selected private investment partners.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.title: What Makes a Real Estate Opportunity Attractive to Us.

paragraphs: An attractive property alone is not sufficient.
For a positive investment assessment, the overall investment case must be compelling.

items.label: Location & Micro-Location
items.text: We assess the economic quality of the location, its development prospects, market demand and long-term attractiveness.

items.label: Project & Development Status
items.text: The site, planning status, permits, construction progress and existing project structure are assessed in accordance with the relevant stage of development.

items.label: Financial Viability
items.text: Acquisition or land costs, development and construction costs, projected revenues, rental or sales prospects and the overall capital structure must be presented transparently and credibly.

items.label: Experience of the Project Partner
items.text: The expertise and track record of the property developer, project developer or investor form an important part of our assessment.

items.label: Equity & Capital Structure
items.text: A transparent presentation of equity already invested or available, together with existing financing arrangements, provides the basis for evaluating a potential investment structure.

items.label: Exit Strategy
items.text: Whether through sale, refinancing or long-term ownership, we require a clear and credible economic perspective from the outset.

paragraphs: Timing is often critical in real estate acquisitions and development projects.
We therefore rely on structured assessment procedures and direct decision-making.
Provided that all required project, corporate and financing documentation is complete, a comprehensive initial investment assessment can generally be completed within three to four weeks.

Following a positive assessment and an initial investment decision, the subsequent structuring, contractual finalization and implementation of the financing can in many cases be completed within a further three to four weeks.
Actual timelines depend on factors including project complexity, development and permitting status, and the extent of the commercial, legal and technical due diligence required.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.title: From Real Estate Opportunity to Investment

items.label: Project Presentation
items.text: Submission of key information regarding the property, location, development status, required capital and intended use of funds.

items.label: Investment Assessment
items.text: Evaluation of the project, financial viability, capital structure, project partners and exit strategy.

items.label: Structuring
items.text: Following a positive assessment, a potential investment and financing structure is developed.

items.label: Due Diligence
items.text: Detailed commercial, legal and, where applicable, technical assessment of the property and project.

items.label: Investment Decision & Implementation
items.text: Following successful completion of due diligence and agreement on the relevant terms, a final investment decision is made and, if approved, the financing is implemented.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.title: You Have the Project. We Evaluate the Capital.

paragraphs: Are you a property developer, project developer, property owner or professional real estate investor seeking private capital for a specific real estate opportunity?
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected real estate financing opportunities with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
Whether for acquisition, development, new construction, redevelopment, expansion or a specific real estate transaction – present your opportunity to us on a confidential basis.

en/Real Estate Financing.odt.label: SUBMIT YOUR REAL ESTATE FINANCING OPPORTUNITY

paragraphs: Argentum Investments SA is not a bank or credit institution and does not provide standardized real estate loans. All investments and financings are subject to individual assessment, due diligence and final investment approval. The timeframes stated are indicative and may vary depending on the structure and complexity of the project and the completeness of the required documentation. The submission or evaluation of a real estate opportunity does not create any entitlement to financing and does not constitute a binding commitment to provide capital.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.title: Capital for Energy Projects with a Long-Term Perspective.

paragraphs: The transformation of the global energy landscape represents one of the most significant investment opportunities of our time.
Solar energy, wind power, energy storage and modern energy infrastructure are creating new opportunities for projects that combine strong economic fundamentals with long-term development potential.

However, a suitable location and a compelling project concept alone do not create a successful energy investment. Technology, permitting, economics, execution and capital structure must work together.
Argentum Investments SA invests in selected renewable energy projects and companies with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
Our focus is on commercially viable opportunities with clearly defined project structures, sound fundamentals and a long-term perspective for sustainable value creation.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.text: Energy is long-term. So is our investment approach.

paragraphs: Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected investment opportunities in the renewable energy sector with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
We consider individual energy projects as well as larger project portfolios, existing assets and companies operating within the energy and infrastructure sectors.
Depending on the stage of the project, capital may be deployed for development, acquisition, construction, commissioning, expansion or scaling.
Installed capacity alone is not the determining factor.

We assess the investment as a whole – from location and technology to project status, permits, projected energy generation, operating costs, commercialization structures and long-term cash flow potential.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.title: Capital for Projects That Generate Energy and Value.

paragraphs: Solar power is one of the key technologies shaping the future of energy generation and offers a broad range of opportunities for long-term investment.
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected solar projects across different stages of development and operation.
These may include:

items.label: Solar Parks & Utility-Scale PV Projects
items.text: Investments in larger photovoltaic installations at suitable locations with transparent project structures and credible revenue potential.

items.label: Commercial & Industrial Solar Projects
items.text: Photovoltaic solutions for industrial, logistics, commercial and other large-scale properties.

items.label: Solar Project Development
items.text: Capital for advanced-stage projects with a clearly defined development status and a realistic path toward implementation.

items.label: Operational Solar Assets
items.text: Investments in completed or operational solar installations with transparent technical and financial track records.

items.label: Solar Portfolios
items.text: Selected portfolios comprising multiple installations or locations with an appropriate investment volume and professional structure.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.title: Capital for Projects with Long-Term Revenue Potential.

paragraphs: Wind power can play a significant role in a diversified and sustainable energy infrastructure.
At the same time, wind energy projects require careful consideration of site quality, permitting, technical planning and commercial viability.
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected wind energy projects where these factors provide a solid foundation for a long-term investment.
These may include:

items.label: Onshore Wind Projects
items.text: Selected wind energy projects located at technically and economically suitable sites.

items.label: Wind Project Development
items.text: Capital for advanced-stage development projects with a transparent permitting process and a credible path toward realization.

items.label: Operational Wind Assets
items.text: Investments in operational wind turbines and wind farms with documented performance and financial track records.

items.label: Repowering
items.text: Capital for the modernization or replacement of existing wind turbines with the objective of improving performance, efficiency and long-term economics.

paragraphs: The future of energy does not end with generation.
As renewable energy becomes an increasingly important part of the energy mix, storage, intelligent management and supporting infrastructure are becoming equally significant.
For this reason, Argentum Investments SA may also consider selected investment opportunities in adjacent sectors.
These may include:

items.label: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
items.text: Large-scale battery storage solutions designed to store electricity and make it available when required.

items.label: Hybrid Energy Projects
items.text: Integrated project structures combining solar, wind and energy storage technologies.

items.label: Energy Infrastructure
items.text: Selected infrastructure projects supporting the distribution, management and efficient use of renewable energy.

items.label: Smart Energy Solutions
items.text: Technologies and systems designed to optimize energy generation, storage, distribution and consumption.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.title: From Project Development to Operational Assets

paragraphs: Not every energy project is at the same stage of development.
We therefore consider investment opportunities across different phases of the project lifecycle.
An advanced project approaching construction presents different investment requirements from an operational solar asset or an established wind farm.
Depending on the individual opportunity, we may consider:

items.label: Development Capital
items.text: Capital for selected advanced-stage project developments where key technical, commercial and regulatory fundamentals are already in place.

items.label: Construction Capital
items.text: Capital for the construction and implementation of appropriately developed and prepared energy projects.

items.label: Acquisition Capital
items.text: Investment capital for the acquisition of individual assets, projects, project companies or energy portfolios.

items.label: Expansion Capital
items.text: Capital for the expansion of existing assets, locations or project portfolios.

items.label: Operational Assets
items.text: Investments in operational energy assets with transparent historical performance and operating data.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.title: An Energy Project Must Make Commercial Sense.

paragraphs: Sustainability alone does not constitute an investment case.
A project must also demonstrate commercial viability.
Depending on the type and stage of the project, our investment assessment therefore considers:

items.label: Location & Resource Quality
items.text: Solar irradiation, wind conditions, site characteristics and long-term technical suitability.

items.label: Project Status & Permits
items.text: Development status, required permits, land rights and other project-specific requirements.

items.label: Grid Connection
items.text: Availability, capacity and status of the planned or existing grid connection.

items.label: Technology & Asset Quality
items.text: Technical concept, components, manufacturers, warranties and expected operational lifetime.

items.label: Energy Yield
items.text: Transparent and credible projections of expected energy generation and their underlying technical assumptions.

items.label: Offtake & Commercialization
items.text: Existing or planned electricity offtake agreements, Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), market-based structures or other revenue models.

items.label: Economics & Cash Flow
items.text: Capital expenditure, operating costs, projected revenues and long-term cash flow potential.

items.label: Project Partners
items.text: Experience and capabilities of developers, operators, EPC contractors and other key project participants.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.title: Capital for Real Assets. A Long-Term Perspective.

paragraphs: Renewable energy projects are fundamentally different from short-term investment models.
They are based on tangible assets, long-term operating structures and – when appropriately structured – potentially predictable economic fundamentals.
It is precisely this combination of infrastructure, technology and long-term value creation that makes selected energy projects attractive to us.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.text: We do not look solely at the construction phase. We consider the entire economic lifecycle of a project.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.title: Our Capital. Selected Private Investment Partners.

paragraphs: In addition to our own investment capabilities, Argentum Investments SA has access to a selected network of private capital providers and investment partners.

Depending on project size, location, development stage and capital requirements, an investment may be considered through our own capital or alongside selected private investment partners from our network.
This enables us to evaluate larger energy projects and portfolios with more substantial capital requirements on an individual basis.
Argentum Investments SA does not operate as a bank, credit institution or traditional financing intermediary.
We evaluate projects and companies as specific investment opportunities in which Argentum Investments SA may participate directly or jointly with selected private investment partners.
Energy projects can represent significant economic value even during their development phase.
Land rights, permits, grid connection capacity, technical plans, offtake arrangements and project agreements therefore require an appropriately confidential approach.
Argentum Investments SA places particular emphasis on a discreet, confidential and structured investment process.
Project and company information is handled selectively and in accordance with the confidentiality requirements applicable to each potential investment.

items.label: Confidential Project Introduction
items.text: Submission of key information regarding the project, location, technology, development status, total investment volume, capital requirements and intended use of funds.

items.label: Investment Assessment
items.text: Evaluation of the project structure, commercial viability, projected energy generation, permits, grid connection, commercialization model and key project partners.

items.label: Technical & Commercial Due Diligence
items.text: Detailed assessment of the relevant technical, commercial, financial, legal and, where applicable, regulatory aspects.

items.label: Investment Structure
items.text: Following a positive assessment, development of a potential capital and investment structure and, where appropriate, involvement of selected investment partners.

items.label: Investment Decision & Implementation
items.text: Following successful completion of the required due diligence, a final investment decision is made and, if approved, the investment is implemented.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.title: You Develop Energy. We Evaluate the Investment Behind It.

paragraphs: Are you developing a solar or wind energy project, managing an existing energy portfolio or seeking capital for the acquisition, construction or expansion of renewable energy assets?
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected renewable energy projects and companies with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
Present your project, its current stage of development and its commercial perspective to us on a confidential basis.

en/Renewable Energy.odt.label: SUBMIT YOUR RENEWABLE ENERGY INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY CONFIDENTIALLY

paragraphs: Every investment is subject to individual assessment, due diligence and final investment approval. Depending on the project, location and stage of development, additional technical, commercial, legal, regulatory and environmental reviews may be required. The submission or evaluation of a project does not create any entitlement to an investment and does not constitute a binding commitment to provide capital. Argentum Investments SA is not a bank or credit institution and does not provide standardized lending products as part of its investment activities.

en/Service. Real Estate.odt.title: Direct Investments. Selected Properties. Sustainable Value.

paragraphs: Real estate represents a dedicated investment area for Argentum Investments SA.
For suitable properties and real estate projects, we act as a direct buyer and investor, evaluating selected investment opportunities with a transaction value starting from EUR 1 million.

We are particularly interested in opportunities presented by property developers, project developers, owners and professional market participants seeking a direct purchaser or investment partner for attractive properties and developments.
Our focus is on real estate opportunities that combine a compelling location with sound economic fundamentals and identifiable development or long-term value potential.

en/Service. Real Estate.odt.title: We Acquire Properties and Projects Directly.

paragraphs: Argentum Investments SA does not operate as a traditional real estate brokerage firm.
Where a property or development meets our investment criteria, we consider a direct acquisition by Argentum Investments SA or an investment through our own investment structures.
This approach enables direct communication and efficient decision-making with property owners, developers and project sponsors.
Our primary focus is on transactions and investment opportunities with a value starting from EUR 1 million.
We welcome direct approaches from property and project developers seeking a purchaser or investment partner for existing or planned real estate developments.
We consider both established projects and properties at various stages of planning and development.

Our assessment takes into account factors including location, project concept, stage of development, economic viability, legal and planning framework, construction-related considerations and the overall quality and long-term potential of the investment.
In addition to conventional real estate projects, we are interested in selected premium and luxury properties.
These may include exceptional residential properties, villas, penthouses, private residences and other distinctive assets in prime locations.
Our assessment is not based solely on the purchase price or size of a property. We place particular emphasis on location, quality, exclusivity and long-term value.

en/Service. Real Estate.odt.title: Selected Real Estate Opportunities for Our Partners & Clients

paragraphs: Not every compelling property or development opportunity is necessarily intended for our own portfolio.
Through our established network, we maintain relationships with selected partners, investors and clients who are specifically interested in distinctive real estate investment opportunities.

Following our initial assessment, suitable properties and developments may therefore also be presented selectively to partners and clients as potential acquisition or investment opportunities, provided that they correspond to their respective investment profiles.
This may be particularly relevant for attractive real estate projects that are still in the planning or development phase and may offer opportunities for an early-stage acquisition or participation.
We do not operate an open real estate sales platform or a high-volume brokerage model. Our approach is selective, discreet and based on specific investment profiles within our established network.
Discretion is particularly important in premium real estate and larger property transactions.
For this reason, we also consider properties and projects that are not intended to be marketed publicly.
Information relating to such opportunities is handled on an individual and confidential basis and, where appropriate, shared selectively with suitable prospective purchasers or investment partners.

en/Service. Real Estate.odt.title: Would You Like to Present a Property or Project?

paragraphs: Are you a property owner, developer or project sponsor looking to sell a property or real estate project with a value starting from EUR 1 million?
Present your opportunity to us.
We will initially assess whether a direct acquisition or investment by Argentum Investments SA may be considered.

Where an opportunity does not correspond to our own investment profile but may be of interest to one of our selected partners or clients, we may, following an appropriate assessment, consider presenting the opportunity selectively within our network.

Every acquisition and investment is subject to individual commercial, legal and, where applicable, technical due diligence. The submission or assessment of a property or project does not constitute an obligation to purchase, an investment commitment or a guarantee of a transaction.
Argentum Investments SA focuses on the evaluation, structuring and financing of selected companies, projects and investment opportunities with capital requirements starting from EUR 1.5 million.

Our approach is deliberately different from that of traditional banks and financial intermediaries. We do not broker standardized loans, nor do we operate as a credit institution. Instead, we evaluate selected opportunities as potential investments and financings for our own participation and within our private investment structures.

Depending on the nature, scale and structure of an opportunity, financing may be provided through our own capital or, where appropriate, together with private capital providers from our investor network.
Time is a critical factor in entrepreneurial ventures. We therefore place particular emphasis on clear structures, direct decision-making and an efficient evaluation process.
Provided that all required information and documentation is complete, the evaluation of a financing opportunity can generally be completed within three to four weeks.

Following a positive assessment and an initial investment decision, the subsequent structuring, finalization and implementation of the financing can in many cases be completed within a further three to four weeks.
This enables us to provide a transparent and focused process – from the initial project assessment through to the potential deployment of capital.

Actual evaluation and implementation times may vary depending on the complexity of the opportunity, the completeness of the documentation, the selected investment structure and any additional legal, technical, financial or commercial due diligence that may be required.
Every potential engagement begins with a thorough understanding of the opportunity.

We analyse the economic and financial position, capital requirements, intended use of funds and the existing corporate or project structure. We also consider the business model, available assets and collateral, the individuals behind the project and its medium- to long-term development prospects.
Based on this assessment, we determine whether an opportunity is aligned with our investment profile and suitable for further evaluation.
A compelling opportunity requires a capital structure that reflects its economic circumstances and strategic objectives.

Following a positive initial assessment, we evaluate which investment or financing structure may be appropriate for the specific opportunity. Depending on the circumstances, different forms of capital, equity participation or individually structured financing solutions may be considered.
Our objective is not to provide a standardized solution, but to develop a structure that takes into account the specific characteristics and economic requirements of each opportunity.
In addition to our own capital, Argentum Investments SA has access to a network of private capital providers who may independently consider selected investment opportunities.
For suitable projects, this creates the possibility of incorporating additional private capital into the respective investment structure.
Any decision to participate in or finance an opportunity is made individually and is subject to the applicable investment criteria and due diligence process.

en/Service.odt.title: From Initial Enquiry to Potential Financing

items.label: Project Submission
items.text: Submission of the key information regarding the company or project, the required amount of capital and the intended use of funds.

items.label: Evaluation | Generally 3–4 Weeks
items.text: Structured assessment of the opportunity and the documentation provided. Where all required documentation is available, we aim to complete the evaluation within three to four weeks.

items.label: Investment Decision
items.text: Following a successful evaluation, a decision is made regarding a potential engagement and the fundamental investment or financing structure.

items.label: Structuring & Finalization
items.text: The commercial, financial and contractual framework of the proposed financing is structured and finalized.

items.label: Implementation | In Many Cases a Further 3–4 Weeks
items.text: Following a positive assessment and agreement on the required terms and conditions, the final implementation of the financing can, in many cases, be completed within a further three to four weeks.

en/Service.odt.title: From the First Conversation to Capital – Clearly Structured.

paragraphs: Our objective is to combine thorough investment decisions with efficient and clearly defined processes.

items.label: Evaluation: generally 3–4 weeks.
items.text: Final implementation following a positive assessment: in many cases a further 3–4 weeks.

paragraphs: This approach provides entrepreneurs and project owners with timely clarity as to whether, and under what conditions, a potential investment by Argentum Investments SA may be considered.

en/Service.odt.title: Financing Starts with a Compelling Opportunity.

paragraphs: Are you seeking private capital for the development, expansion or realization of a company or project?
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected opportunities with financing requirements starting from EUR 1.5 million.

Argentum Investments SA is not a bank or credit institution and does not provide conventional credit brokerage services. All investments and financings are subject to individual assessment, due diligence and approval. The timeframes stated above are indicative and may vary depending on the scope and complexity of the opportunity and the completeness of the required documentation. The submission or evaluation of an opportunity does not create any entitlement to financing or constitute a commitment to provide funding.

en/Start-up Investments.odt.title: Turning a Strong Idea into a Significant Business.

paragraphs: Every successful company begins with a vision. What ultimately matters, however, is the ability to transform that vision into a scalable business model, a relevant market position and sustainable long-term enterprise value.
Argentum Investments SA invests in selected start-ups and emerging growth companies that are ready to take the next decisive step in their development.
Our focus is on investment opportunities starting from EUR 2 million.

We seek founders and companies that offer more than a compelling idea. We look for businesses that can demonstrate genuine potential to establish a sustainable market position, scale their operations and create long-term value.
The transition from successful market entry to sustainable scaling is often one of the most capital-intensive and strategically important stages in a company's development.
This is where we aim to invest.
Argentum Investments SA evaluates start-up investments starting from EUR 2 million where additional capital can make a meaningful contribution to the company's next stage of development.

Investment capital may be used to scale the business model, expand sales and production capabilities, accelerate product development, enter international markets, strengthen the team or build the organizational structures required for further growth.
Our objective is not to provide short-term financing for an idea.

en/Start-up Investments.odt.text: Our objective is to invest in companies with the potential to transform a compelling idea into a sustainable and successful business.

en/Start-up Investments.odt.title: We Invest in Potential That Is Already Becoming Visible.

paragraphs: A vision is the beginning. An investment decision requires more.
We are particularly interested in start-ups that have already achieved meaningful milestones and can clearly demonstrate how additional capital will enable them to scale.
Our assessment considers, among other factors:

items.label: Product & Innovation
items.text: A clearly defined product, technology or solution offering identifiable customer value and meaningful differentiation.

items.label: Market & Demand
items.text: A relevant target market with demonstrable demand and credible opportunities for continued growth.

items.label: Traction & Development
items.text: Initial customers, revenues, partnerships, market validation or other measurable evidence demonstrating that the business model works.

items.label: Founders & Management
items.text: A strong team with relevant expertise, entrepreneurial commitment and the ability to execute an ambitious strategy.

items.label: Scalability
items.text: A business model capable of growing beyond its current size and expanding into new markets or customer segments.

items.label: Capital Strategy
items.text: A transparent and credible plan explaining how the investment will be deployed and which specific milestones are expected to be achieved.

paragraphs: The right investment should do more than provide liquidity. It should create new opportunities.
Argentum Investments SA therefore evaluates every investment from an entrepreneurial perspective.
We seek to understand where a company can go, which market position it can realistically achieve and how additional capital can contribute to sustainable long-term value creation.
We are not looking to provide short-term financing solutions. We seek companies where capital can serve as a strategic driver of growth.

en/Start-up Investments.odt.title: Investing Alongside Our Private Investment Network

paragraphs: Depending on the sector, stage of development, capital requirements and structure of the company, Argentum Investments SA may invest through its own capital or alongside selected private investment partners from our network.
This approach enables us to consider different participation structures and, where appropriate, larger growth investments.

We do not act as a traditional capital intermediary. Each company is evaluated as a specific investment opportunity in which Argentum Investments SA may participate directly or jointly with selected investment partners.
An investment should enable growth without losing sight of the entrepreneurial identity that created the company.
We value founders who take responsibility, make clear decisions and pursue a long-term vision for their business.

Our role as an investor is not to replace the entrepreneurial vision, but to evaluate how capital, experience and the right structures can help accelerate and sustainably develop the potential that already exists.

en/Start-up Investments.odt.text: Strong founders build companies. The right capital can help them develop into market leaders.

paragraphs: We are open to opportunities across different industries where the business model and investment case are compelling.

We are particularly interested in companies with innovative products or services, technology-driven solutions, digital business models, scalable platforms and businesses operating in forward-looking, high-growth markets.
The sector alone is not decisive.
What matters is whether the company can provide compelling answers to three fundamental questions:

items.label: Why this product?
items.text: What specific problem does it solve, and what tangible value does it create for the customer?

items.label: Why this market?
items.text: How significant is the opportunity, and why can the company establish a relevant position within it?

items.label: Why this team?
items.text: Why are these founders and this management team uniquely positioned to turn the vision into a successful business?

items.label: Present Your Start-up
items.text: Submit your pitch deck, business model, key financial information, capital requirements and intended use of funds.

items.label: Investment Assessment
items.text: Evaluation of the market, product, management team, traction, financial planning and growth potential.

items.label: Founder Meeting
items.text: Following a positive initial assessment, we want to understand the founders, their vision and the long-term strategy behind the company.

items.label: Due Diligence & Investment Structure
items.text: Detailed assessment and development of a potential investment structure. For suitable opportunities, selected partners from our private investment network may participate.

items.label: Investment & the Next Stage of Growth
items.text: Following successful completion of due diligence, a final investment decision is made and, where approved, the investment is implemented.

en/Start-up Investments.odt.title: Ready to Turn Growth into Scale?

paragraphs: You have more than an idea.
You have built a company, achieved meaningful milestones and know where the next stage of development should take you.
Now you are looking for the capital to make that next decisive move.
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected start-up and growth investment opportunities with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.

Every investment is subject to individual assessment, due diligence and final investment approval. The submission or evaluation of a company does not create any entitlement to investment and does not constitute a binding commitment to provide capital. Any participation by additional investment partners is subject to their own independent assessment and investment decision.

en/Technology Solutions & E-Mobility.odt.title: Capital for Technologies That Transform Markets.

paragraphs: Technological progress is driven by more than an innovative idea. What ultimately matters is the ability to transform technology into a scalable, commercially viable and sustainable solution with long-term market relevance.

Argentum Investments SA invests in selected technology companies, innovative business models and e-mobility projects that demonstrate a compelling technological foundation and clearly identifiable market potential.
Our focus is on investment opportunities starting from EUR 2 million.
We seek companies and projects where capital can enable a decisive stage of development – from technological advancement and industrialization to scaling and international expansion.

en/Technology Solutions & E-Mobility.odt.text: We do not invest in technology for technology’s sake. We invest in solutions with genuine commercial potential.

paragraphs: Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected technology and e-mobility investment opportunities with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
We consider established technology companies as well as innovative growth businesses and advanced-stage projects.
The decisive factor is the combination of technology, genuine market demand and a commercially viable business model.
Our assessment therefore extends beyond the technological innovation itself.

We seek to understand the problem being solved, the tangible value the technology creates, the size of the addressable market and how the underlying business can develop into a sustainably scalable company.
A technology can be exceptional – but its economic value is ultimately created through successful execution.
In technology-driven markets, the transition from product development to commercial and international scaling often requires substantial capital.
Investment capital may be deployed for:

items.label: Technology & Product Development
items.text: Further development of existing technologies, products, platforms and technical solutions.

items.label: Industrialization & Production
items.text: Establishment and expansion of production capabilities and the transition from prototypes or small-scale production to industrial manufacturing.

items.label: Market Launch & Commercialization
items.text: Capital supporting the successful market positioning and commercialization of new technologies and products.

items.label: Scaling
items.text: Expansion of sales, infrastructure, production and operational capabilities to meet increasing demand.

items.label: International Expansion
items.text: Entry into new markets and development of international sales, production and strategic partnership structures.

items.label: Strategic Acquisitions
items.text: Capital for the acquisition of complementary technologies, companies, patents or strategically relevant market positions.

en/Technology Solutions & E-Mobility.odt.title: E-Mobility – Capital for the Next Generation of Mobility.

paragraphs: The transformation of mobility is creating new markets, technologies and business models.
E-mobility extends far beyond the vehicle itself.
Charging infrastructure, energy management, battery systems, software, fleet solutions and intelligent infrastructure are becoming part of an increasingly interconnected economic ecosystem.
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected investment opportunities across this value chain.
We are particularly interested in companies and projects developing scalable solutions for the future of mobility and energy infrastructure.
Our approach is deliberately technology-neutral.
We consider investment opportunities particularly in areas such as:

items.label: E-Mobility & Electric Vehicles
items.text: Innovative vehicle concepts, components, systems and solutions for electric mobility.

items.label: Charging Infrastructure
items.text: Charging infrastructure, fast-charging systems, charging hubs and intelligent solutions for private, commercial and public applications.

items.label: Battery & Energy Storage
items.text: Battery technologies, energy storage systems, battery management and solutions designed to optimize energy efficiency and lifecycle performance.

items.label: Energy Management & Smart Infrastructure
items.text: Technologies for the intelligent management of energy, charging processes, buildings, grids and decentralized energy systems.

items.label: Software & Digital Platforms
items.text: Scalable software solutions, digital platforms, data-driven models and technology-enabled business models.

items.label: Artificial Intelligence & Automation
items.text: Applications of artificial intelligence, automation and data-driven technologies with clearly defined commercial value.

items.label: Industrial & Deep Technology
items.text: Technologies for industrial applications, manufacturing, engineering, automation and advanced technical solutions.

en/Technology Solutions & E-Mobility.odt.title: Technology Must Do More Than Impress.

paragraphs: An innovative technology alone does not constitute a compelling investment case.
For us, an attractive investment opportunity emerges from the combination of technological differentiation, genuine market demand and commercial scalability.
Our assessment therefore focuses particularly on:

items.label: Technology & Differentiation
items.text: What technological advantage does the solution provide, and how does it differentiate itself from existing alternatives?

items.label: Market & Demand
items.text: What specific problem does the technology solve, and how large is the addressable market?

items.label: Validation & Development Stage
items.text: Are prototypes, pilot projects, customers, revenues, strategic partnerships or other credible forms of validation already in place?

items.label: Intellectual Property
items.text: Are patents, proprietary rights, proprietary technologies or other relevant technological competitive advantages in place?

items.label: Scalability
items.text: Can the technology be economically scaled across larger production volumes, markets or applications?

items.label: Management & Technical Expertise
items.text: Does the team possess the entrepreneurial and technical capabilities required to transform an innovation into a sustainably successful business?

items.label: Capital Strategy
items.text: Which specific milestones are expected to be achieved through the investment, and how will the capital contribute to the long-term value creation of the company?

en/Technology Solutions & E-Mobility.odt.title: Capital for Infrastructure & Larger Technology Projects

paragraphs: Not every technology investment is limited to a single company.
Particularly in e-mobility, charging infrastructure, energy and industrial technology, larger projects and roll-out strategies can require substantial amounts of capital.
In addition to corporate investments, Argentum Investments SA may therefore evaluate selected project-based investment opportunities.
Our assessment focuses on a transparent project structure, sound economics, clearly defined responsibilities and a realistic perspective for long-term value creation.

en/Technology Solutions & E-Mobility.odt.title: Our Capital. Private Investment Partners. Shared Opportunities.

paragraphs: In addition to our own investment capabilities, Argentum Investments SA has access to a selected network of private capital providers and investment partners.

Depending on the technology, project size, development stage and capital requirements, an investment may be considered through our own capital or alongside selected private investment partners from our network.
This enables us to evaluate larger growth, infrastructure and technology investments on an individual basis.
Argentum Investments SA does not operate as a bank, credit institution or traditional capital intermediary.
We evaluate companies and projects as specific investment opportunities in which Argentum Investments SA may participate directly or jointly with selected private investment partners.
Technology companies are built on knowledge, development and competitive advantage.

Business models, technical documentation, proprietary technologies, patents, development plans, customer relationships and strategic partnerships can represent a substantial part of a company’s value.
We therefore place particular emphasis on a discreet, confidential and structured investment process.
Confidential information is handled selectively and in accordance with the specific confidentiality requirements of each potential investment.

items.label: Confidential Introduction
items.text: Submission of key information regarding the company or project, technology, development stage, capital requirements and intended use of funds.

items.label: Investment Assessment
items.text: Evaluation of the technology, market, business model, management, capital structure and scalability potential.

items.label: Technical & Commercial Due Diligence
items.text: Detailed assessment of the relevant technical, commercial, financial and legal aspects.

items.label: Investment Structure
items.text: Following a positive assessment, development of a potential investment structure and, where appropriate, involvement of selected investment partners.

items.label: Investment Decision & Implementation
items.text: Following successful completion of the required due diligence, a final investment decision is made and, if approved, the investment is implemented.

en/Technology Solutions & E-Mobility.odt.title: Technology Shapes the Future. Capital Enables Scale.

paragraphs: Have you developed a technology, built an innovative company or established a project in e-mobility, energy or digital infrastructure and are now seeking capital for the next decisive stage of development?
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected technology and e-mobility investment opportunities with capital requirements starting from EUR 2 million.
Present your technology, business model and vision for the next stage of development to us on a confidential basis.

en/Technology Solutions & E-Mobility.odt.label: SUBMIT YOUR TECHNOLOGY & E-MOBILITY INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY CONFIDENTIALLY

paragraphs: Every investment is subject to individual assessment, due diligence and final investment approval. Depending on the technology and nature of the opportunity, additional technical, commercial, regulatory and legal reviews may be required. The submission or evaluation of a company, technology or project does not create any entitlement to an investment and does not constitute a binding commitment to provide capital. Argentum Investments SA is not a bank or credit institution and does not provide standardized lending products as part of its investment activities.

en/Ventuere Capital.odt.title: Capital for Companies with Growth Potential.

paragraphs: Argentum Investments SA invests in selected companies and entrepreneurial ventures with compelling business models, clear growth strategies and sustainable development potential.
Within Venture Capital, we focus on investments starting from EUR 2 million.

Our approach extends beyond the provision of capital. We seek companies where a strong entrepreneurial vision is supported by a viable business model, an attractive market opportunity and clearly identifiable potential for scalability and long-term value creation.
Our Venture Capital activities are focused on companies seeking investment capital starting from EUR 2 million.

Every investment opportunity is assessed individually. Our evaluation considers, among other factors, the business model, market positioning, management team, company development, capital requirements and the intended use of the investment proceeds.
Particular attention is given to how additional capital can support the company in reaching its next significant stage of development and growth.

en/Ventuere Capital.odt.title: Investing Together with Our Private Investment Network

paragraphs: A key element of our investment approach is our established network of private capital providers and investment partners.
Depending on the size, sector and structure of an opportunity, Argentum Investments SA may invest through its own capital or alongside selected investment partners from our network.
This enables us to consider different investment structures and, where appropriate, larger capital requirements for suitable companies.

Argentum Investments SA does not act as a traditional capital or credit intermediary. Companies presented to us are evaluated as specific investment opportunities in which we may participate directly or jointly with selected investment partners.
Not every innovative idea automatically represents an investment opportunity.

For us, economic substance and entrepreneurial potential are fundamental. A company should not only present a compelling vision, but also demonstrate how that vision can be transformed into a sustainable, scalable and commercially viable business.
Key factors in our investment assessment include:

items.label: A Compelling Business Model
items.text: A clearly defined product, service or solution with identifiable customer value and commercial potential.

items.label: A Scalable Market Opportunity
items.text: An attractive market environment with credible opportunities for growth, expansion and scalability.

items.label: A Strong Management Team
items.text: Entrepreneurs and management teams with the expertise, commitment and strategic vision required to develop the business.

items.label: Transparent Financials
items.text: A clear presentation of historical development, financial planning, capital requirements and the intended use of investment proceeds.

items.label: A Defined Growth Strategy
items.text: A concrete strategy demonstrating how the investment will contribute to the company's continued development and long-term value creation.

paragraphs: We view Venture Capital as a long-term entrepreneurial partnership.

Our objective is to deploy capital where it can make a meaningful contribution to the next stage of growth – whether through expansion, internationalization, market entry, product development, scaling operations or the continued development of the company.
By combining our own investment capabilities with selected private investment partners, we are able to evaluate and structure more substantial growth investments on an individual basis.

items.label: Company Presentation
items.text: Submission of key company information, the business model, required investment amount and intended use of funds.

items.label: Initial Investment Assessment
items.text: Evaluation of the company and determination of whether the opportunity is generally aligned with our Venture Capital investment profile.

items.label: In-Depth Evaluation
items.text: Following a positive initial assessment, a more detailed commercial, financial and structural review is conducted.

items.label: Investment Structure
items.text: Definition of a potential equity and capital structure and, where appropriate, the involvement of selected investment partners from our network.

items.label: Investment Decision & Implementation
items.text: Following successful completion of the required due diligence, a final decision is made regarding the potential investment and its implementation.

en/Ventuere Capital.odt.title: Ready for the Next Stage of Growth?

paragraphs: Are you building a company with a compelling business model and seeking growth capital starting from EUR 2 million?
Present your company and growth strategy to us.
Argentum Investments SA evaluates selected Venture Capital opportunities for direct investment as well as potential co-investments alongside selected partners from our private investment network.

Every investment is subject to individual assessment, due diligence and approval. The submission or evaluation of a company does not create any entitlement to investment and does not constitute a binding commitment to provide capital. The participation of additional investment partners is subject to their own independent assessment and investment decision.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Du capital pour des projets énergétiques à long terme.

paragraphs: La transformation du paysage énergétique mondial représente l’un des domaines d’investissement les plus importants de notre époque.

L’énergie solaire, l’énergie éolienne, le stockage d’énergie et les infrastructures énergétiques modernes créent de nouvelles opportunités pour des projets associant des fondamentaux économiques solides à un potentiel de développement à long terme.

Cependant, un emplacement approprié et un concept convaincant ne suffisent pas à garantir la réussite d’un projet énergétique. La technologie, les autorisations, la viabilité économique, la mise en œuvre et la structure du capital doivent être parfaitement coordonnées.
Argentum Investments SA investit dans des entreprises et des projets sélectionnés dans le domaine des énergies renouvelables présentant des besoins en capitaux à partir de 2 millions d’euros.
Nous privilégions des opportunités économiquement viables, reposant sur une structure de projet clairement définie, des fondamentaux solides et une perspective de création de valeur durable.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.text: L’énergie s’inscrit dans le long terme. Notre approche d’investissement également.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Investissements à partir de 2 millions d’euros

paragraphs: Argentum Investments SA examine des opportunités d’investissement sélectionnées dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables présentant des besoins en capitaux à partir de 2 millions d’euros.

Nous pouvons nous intéresser aussi bien à des projets énergétiques individuels qu’à des portefeuilles de projets de plus grande envergure, à des actifs existants ainsi qu’à des entreprises opérant dans les secteurs de l’énergie et des infrastructures.
Selon le stade d’avancement du projet, les capitaux peuvent être destinés au développement, à l’acquisition, à la construction, à la mise en service, à l’extension ou au changement d’échelle.
La puissance installée n’est pas, à elle seule, le facteur déterminant.

Nous analysons l’investissement dans sa globalité – depuis l’emplacement et la technologie jusqu’au stade d’avancement du projet, aux autorisations, à la production énergétique prévisionnelle, aux coûts d’exploitation, au modèle de commercialisation et au potentiel de flux de trésorerie à long terme.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Du capital pour des projets qui génèrent de l’énergie et de la valeur.

paragraphs: L’énergie photovoltaïque constitue l’une des technologies essentielles de la future production énergétique et offre de nombreuses possibilités d’investissement à long terme.
Argentum Investments SA examine des projets solaires sélectionnés à différents stades de développement et d’exploitation.
Il peut notamment s’agir de :

items.label: Parcs solaires & installations photovoltaïques de grande envergure
items.text: Investissements dans des installations photovoltaïques importantes situées sur des sites adaptés, présentant une structure de projet transparente et un potentiel de revenus crédible.

items.label: Installations solaires commerciales & industrielles
items.text: Solutions photovoltaïques destinées aux sites industriels, logistiques, commerciaux et à d’autres actifs immobiliers de grande envergure.

items.label: Développement de projets solaires
items.text: Capitaux destinés à des projets avancés présentant un stade de développement clairement défini et une perspective réaliste de réalisation.

items.label: Actifs solaires opérationnels
items.text: Investissements dans des installations déjà construites ou en exploitation disposant d’un historique technique et financier transparent.

items.label: Portefeuilles solaires
items.text: Portefeuilles sélectionnés regroupant plusieurs installations ou sites et présentant un volume d’investissement ainsi qu’une structure professionnelle adaptés.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Du capital pour des projets présentant un potentiel de rendement à long terme.

paragraphs: L’énergie éolienne peut jouer un rôle majeur dans le développement d’une infrastructure énergétique diversifiée et durable.
Dans le même temps, les projets éoliens nécessitent une analyse rigoureuse de la qualité du site, des autorisations, de la planification technique et de leur viabilité économique.
Argentum Investments SA examine des projets éoliens sélectionnés lorsque ces différents éléments constituent une base solide pour un investissement à long terme.
Il peut notamment s’agir de :

items.label: Projets éoliens terrestres
items.text: Projets sélectionnés implantés sur des sites présentant des conditions techniques et économiques adaptées.

items.label: Développement de parcs éoliens
items.text: Capitaux destinés à des projets de développement avancés disposant d’un processus d’autorisation clairement défini et d’une perspective crédible de réalisation.

items.label: Actifs éoliens opérationnels
items.text: Investissements dans des éoliennes et des parcs éoliens en exploitation disposant de performances documentées et d’un historique économique transparent.

items.label: Repowering
items.text: Capitaux destinés à la modernisation ou au remplacement d’installations existantes afin d’améliorer leur performance, leur efficacité et leur rentabilité à long terme.

paragraphs: L’avenir de l’énergie ne se limite pas à sa production.
À mesure que les énergies renouvelables occupent une place croissante dans le mix énergétique, le stockage, la gestion intelligente et les infrastructures associées deviennent tout aussi essentiels.
Argentum Investments SA peut donc également examiner des opportunités d’investissement sélectionnées dans des secteurs complémentaires.
Il peut notamment s’agir de :

items.label: Systèmes de stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS)
items.text: Solutions de stockage à grande échelle permettant de stocker l’électricité et de la restituer en fonction des besoins.

items.label: Projets énergétiques hybrides
items.text: Structures intégrées combinant technologies solaires, éoliennes et systèmes de stockage d’énergie.

items.label: Infrastructures énergétiques
items.text: Projets d’infrastructure sélectionnés destinés à soutenir la distribution, la gestion et l’utilisation efficace des énergies renouvelables.

items.label: Solutions énergétiques intelligentes
items.text: Technologies et systèmes destinés à optimiser la production, le stockage, la distribution et la consommation d’énergie.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Du développement du projet à l’actif opérationnel

paragraphs: Tous les projets énergétiques ne se trouvent pas au même stade de développement.
Nous examinons donc des opportunités d’investissement à différentes étapes du cycle de vie d’un projet.
Un projet avancé proche du début de sa construction présente des caractéristiques d’investissement différentes de celles d’une installation solaire déjà opérationnelle ou d’un parc éolien établi.
Selon l’opportunité, nous pouvons notamment examiner :

items.label: Capital de développement
items.text: Capitaux destinés à des projets avancés pour lesquels les principales bases techniques, économiques et réglementaires ont déjà été établies.

items.label: Capital de construction
items.text: Capitaux destinés à la construction et à la réalisation de projets énergétiques suffisamment développés et préparés.

items.label: Capital d’acquisition
items.text: Capitaux destinés à l’acquisition d’actifs individuels, de projets, de sociétés de projet ou de portefeuilles énergétiques.

items.label: Capital d’expansion
items.text: Capitaux destinés à l’extension d’actifs, de sites ou de portefeuilles de projets existants.

items.label: Actifs opérationnels
items.text: Investissements dans des actifs énergétiques déjà en exploitation disposant de données de performance et d’exploitation transparentes.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Un projet énergétique doit être économiquement convaincant.

paragraphs: La durabilité ne constitue pas, à elle seule, un dossier d’investissement.
Un projet doit également démontrer sa viabilité économique.
Selon la nature et le stade de développement du projet, notre analyse porte notamment sur :

items.label: Emplacement & qualité des ressources
items.text: Ensoleillement, conditions de vent, caractéristiques du site et adéquation technique à long terme.

items.label: État d’avancement & autorisations
items.text: Stade de développement, autorisations nécessaires, droits fonciers et autres conditions spécifiques au projet.

items.label: Raccordement au réseau
items.text: Disponibilité, capacité et état d’avancement du raccordement prévu ou existant au réseau électrique.

items.label: Technologie & qualité des équipements
items.text: Conception technique, composants utilisés, fabricants, garanties et durée de vie opérationnelle prévue.

items.label: Production énergétique
items.text: Prévisions transparentes et crédibles de la production d’énergie attendue ainsi que leurs hypothèses techniques.

items.label: Commercialisation & contrats d’achat d’électricité
items.text: Contrats existants ou prévus, notamment les Power Purchase Agreements (PPA), modèles de marché ou autres structures de revenus.

items.label: Rentabilité & flux de trésorerie
items.text: Dépenses d’investissement, coûts d’exploitation, revenus prévisionnels et potentiel de flux de trésorerie à long terme.

items.label: Partenaires du projet
items.text: Expérience et capacités des développeurs, exploitants, entreprises EPC et autres partenaires essentiels au projet.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Du capital pour des actifs réels. Une vision à long terme.

paragraphs: Les projets d’énergies renouvelables se distinguent fondamentalement des modèles d’investissement à court terme.
Ils reposent sur des actifs tangibles, des structures d’exploitation à long terme et – lorsqu’ils sont correctement structurés – des fondamentaux économiques potentiellement prévisibles.
C’est précisément cette combinaison entre infrastructures, technologie et création de valeur à long terme qui rend certains projets énergétiques particulièrement intéressants pour nous.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.text: Nous ne considérons pas uniquement la phase de construction. Nous analysons l’ensemble du cycle de vie économique du projet.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Nos capitaux. Des partenaires d’investissement privés sélectionnés.

paragraphs: Outre ses propres capacités d’investissement, Argentum Investments SA dispose d’un réseau sélectionné d’investisseurs privés et de partenaires d’investissement.

Selon la taille du projet, son emplacement, son stade de développement et ses besoins en capitaux, un investissement peut être envisagé au moyen de nos propres capitaux ou aux côtés de partenaires d’investissement privés sélectionnés au sein de notre réseau.
Cette approche nous permet d’examiner individuellement des projets énergétiques et des portefeuilles de plus grande envergure nécessitant des capitaux plus importants.
Argentum Investments SA n’agit pas comme une banque, un établissement de crédit ou un intermédiaire traditionnel en financement.

Nous examinons les projets et les entreprises comme des opportunités d’investissement spécifiques auxquelles Argentum Investments SA peut participer directement ou conjointement avec des partenaires d’investissement privés sélectionnés.
Les projets énergétiques peuvent représenter une valeur économique significative dès leur phase de développement.

Les droits fonciers, autorisations, capacités de raccordement au réseau, plans techniques, accords d’achat d’électricité et contrats liés au projet nécessitent donc un traitement particulièrement confidentiel.
Argentum Investments SA accorde une importance particulière à un processus d’investissement discret, confidentiel et structuré.
Les informations relatives aux projets et aux entreprises sont traitées de manière ciblée et conformément aux exigences de confidentialité applicables à chaque investissement potentiel.

items.label: Présentation confidentielle du projet
items.text: Transmission des principales informations relatives au projet, à son emplacement, à la technologie, au stade de développement, au volume total d’investissement, aux besoins en capitaux et à l’utilisation prévue des fonds.

items.label: Évaluation de l’investissement
items.text: Analyse de la structure du projet, de sa viabilité économique, de la production énergétique prévisionnelle, des autorisations, du raccordement au réseau, du modèle de commercialisation et des principaux partenaires.

items.label: Due diligence technique & économique
items.text: Analyse approfondie des aspects techniques, économiques, financiers, juridiques et, le cas échéant, réglementaires pertinents.

items.label: Structure d’investissement
items.text: À la suite d’une évaluation positive, élaboration d’une structure de capital et d’investissement potentielle et, le cas échéant, implication de partenaires d’investissement sélectionnés.

items.label: Décision d’investissement & mise en œuvre
items.text: Après réalisation satisfaisante des vérifications requises, une décision finale d’investissement est prise et, en cas d’approbation, l’investissement est mis en œuvre.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.title: Vous développez l’énergie. Nous évaluons l’investissement qui se trouve derrière.

paragraphs: Vous développez un projet solaire ou éolien, gérez un portefeuille énergétique existant ou recherchez des capitaux pour l’acquisition, la construction ou l’extension d’actifs dans le domaine des énergies renouvelables ?
Argentum Investments SA examine des entreprises et des projets sélectionnés dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables présentant des besoins en capitaux à partir de 2 millions d’euros.
Présentez-nous votre projet en toute confidentialité, son stade actuel de développement ainsi que ses perspectives économiques.

Énergies renouvelables.odt.label: SOUMETTEZ CONFIDENTIELLEMENT VOTRE OPPORTUNITÉ D’INVESTISSEMENT DANS LES ÉNERGIES RENOUVELABLES

paragraphs: Tout investissement est soumis à une évaluation individuelle, à une procédure de due diligence et à une décision finale d’investissement. Selon le projet, son emplacement et son stade de développement, des vérifications techniques, économiques, juridiques, réglementaires et environnementales supplémentaires peuvent être nécessaires. La présentation ou l’évaluation d’un projet ne confère aucun droit à un investissement et ne constitue aucun engagement ferme de mise à disposition de capitaux. Argentum Investments SA n’est ni une banque ni un établissement de crédit et ne propose pas de produits de crédit standardisés dans le cadre de ses activités d’investissement.
